authorisation: Product-Owner mission of 2026-09-26: remove the retired development appliance's literal address from the current repository tree and every generated and exported project material, preserving historical meaning and evidence, with a forward receipt, through the protected PR path. It did NOT authorise rewriting Git history, changing a historical fact or outcome, changing runtime or product behaviour, deploying anything or contacting any appliance or environment.
what_this_is: A redaction of the CURRENT TREE, not a correction of history. Every record that named the retired development reference appliance by its literal address now names it by role -- 'the retired development reference appliance', or the role noun it already had followed by '(now retired)'. What each record says happened, where, when and with what result is unchanged. The original wording remains in Git history, which was not rewritten.
does_not_invalidate_history: No historical evidence is invalidated. The receipts, acceptance records, evidence, reports and plans that were edited kept their facts, dates, verdicts and outcomes; only the literal address was replaced. Earlier receipts are amended in the current tree for this one purpose, by this receipt's authority, and Git history shows exactly what each said before.

The three PHASE7 guard scripts assemble the same address from its octets and still refuse it.
behaviour_preserved.tests: Go test fixtures for sysnet, netcfg and netd use the RFC 5737 documentation range instead; go test for those three packages passes and gofmt is clean.
behaviour_preserved.dev_bootstrap: scripts/phase3-bootstrap.sh no longer lists the retired appliance's origin among the local development CORS origins; it is a local development script and that host is out of bounds.
behaviour_preserved.migration_0048: A comment-only change. Migration checksums are enforced only when a migration is applied; 0048 is long applied, and fresh installs start from the production baseline.
behaviour_preserved.runtime: No runtime or product behaviour changed; nothing was built or deployed.
